spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (रहति) r. 10th. cl. (रहयति)
To quit, to leave, to forego, to lose or abandon.
With वि,
To be separate or away from.
(इ) रहि r. 1st cl. (रंहति)
To go, to move with speed.

m. (-हः)
Solitariness, privacy.
E.
रह to be private, अच् aff.

n. (-णं)
Quitting, leaving.
E.
रह to leave, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-हन्-हन्ती-हत्)
Leaving, abandoning.
E.
रह to leave, शतृ aff.

n. subst. (-हः)
1 Solitariness, privacy.
2

Copulation.
3

A privity.
4 A religious or mystic truth.
ind. or n. adv. (-हः)
Solitary, private, in private, secretly, privily.
E.
रह to abandon, (society, &c.,) and असुन् aff., or रम to sport or play, with the same aff., and अह substituted for the radical finals.

m. (-सः)
1 The ocean.
2 Heaven.
E.
रह to leave, असच् aff.

mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं)
Private, secret, either fit to be concealed or occurring in secret.
n. (-स्यं)
A secret, a mystery, any thing hidden, recondite or mysterious.
f. (-स्या)
The name of a river, perhaps the Sarasvatī, from its being supposed to flow in an unknown channel.
E.
रहस् secret, and यत् aff.

m. (-टः)
1 A counsellor, a minister.
2 A ghost, a spirit.
3 Spring.
E.
रह privately, अट to go, aff. अच्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Left, quitted, abandoned.
2 Free from, devoid of.
E.
रह to leave, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Alone, solitary, in private.
E.
रह, and भूत been, with च्चि aug.

m. (-हुः)
The ascending node; in mythology, the son of SIṂHIKĀ, a Daitya, with the tail of a dragon, whose head was severed from his body by VIṢṆU, but being immortal, the head and tail retained their separate existence, and being transferred to the stellar sphere, became the authors of eclipses; the first especially, by endeavouring at various times to swallow the sun and moon.
E.
रह to abandon, (the planets which it has vainly attempted to devour,) aff. उ, and the vowel made long.

m. (-स्तः)
Eclipsed, (as the sun or moon.)
E.
राहु, and ग्रस्त seized.

m. (-सः)
Immersion of a planet in an eclipse.
E.
राहु, and ग्रास mouthful.

m. (-हः)
An eclipse of the sun or moon.
E.
राहु the dragon's head, and ग्राह seizure.

m. (-दी)
VIṢṆU.
E.
राहु the Daitya, भेदिन् the divider.

m. (-भिद्)
VIṢṆU.
E.
राहु the Daitya, मूर्द्ध the head, and भिट् who divides, who decapitates.

m. (-सूः)
A name of the legislator Buddha or Śākyasiṃha.

m. (-र्शः)
An eclipse.
E.
राहु the dragon's head, and संस्पर्श seizure, contact.

m. (-हा)
VIṢṆU.
E.
राहु the Daitya, and हन् destroyer.

m. (-ष्टः)
Garlick.
E.
राहु the demon, उच्छिष्ट vomited.

m. (-ष्टः)
Garlick.
E.
राहू the Daitya, and उत्सृष्ट created.
